port.name: CSS variables
port.description: Living Code for CSS variables. Repository-owned theme files, installation instructions and four color flavors.

guide.installation:
```sh
pnpm add @living-code/css
```

Import the stylesheet in your app:

```css
@import "@living-code/css/living-code.css";
```

Or load it directly in HTML:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="living-code.css" />
<html data-theme="living-code-night">
```

Use palette names (`var(--lc-teal)`) or semantic roles (`var(--lc-keyword)`, `var(--lc-bg)`, `var(--lc-border-active)`).
guide.configuration: See [CSS variables's documentation](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/CSS/color_value/oklch) for application settings and reload behavior. The activation instructions above identify each supported flavor; keep your other application configuration.
guide.compatibility: Preserves the npm package name `@living-code/css` and its existing import paths. Package publication and registry credentials are separate from creating this repository.
